note.title: Teacher targets/extension structures
note.overview: This lesson contains 54 enabled questions. It teaches Teacher targets/extension structures through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Teacher targets/extension structures.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Underline the auxiliary, not the participle.
Use non-je subjects accurately in the perfect tense.
Add agreement for taught être/reflexive verbs.
Negative perfect: ne + auxiliary + negative word + participle.
Learn Super Structures as fixed chunks.
